newsitem.title: CHINA: McDonnell aims for 30 pct of China jet market.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell aims for 30 pct of China jet market.

text.p: U.S. aircraft maker McDonnell Douglas Corp aims to increase its share of the China market to 30 percent from the current 20 percent, the China Daily said on Wednesday, quoting company chairman John McDonnell.
"We would like to obtain a 30 percent market share (in China)," the paper quoted McDonnell as saying in the southern Chinese city of Zhuhai where he is attending an aviation and aerospace exhibition.
"We ... will continue to aggressively market our family of commercial jets in order to meet the needs of the growing Chinese aviation market," he said.

McDonnell did not give a timetable or elaborate on how the aircraft maker hoped to boost its market share. Boeing Co and European consortium Airbus Industrie have been major competitors in China as in the other markets.
McDonnell Douglas estimates that China needs 1,350 new aircraft over the next 20 years, the newspaper said.
